automation: One bounded ready task; no autonomous paid prompt loop

tasks.title: Repository kernel operating system
tasks.goal: Keep requirements, backlog and skills discoverable without loading everything.
acceptance: Spec records supplied changes and unknown details.
One active project skill routes to one task.
Upstream bundles have pinned revisions and hashes.
evidence: 10 official public skill bundles pinned and hash-verified; one small project router active
npm run kernel:next returns only the next task
305 regression tests and production build pass for the current foundation

tasks.title: Public connector protocol foundation
tasks.goal: Implement TikTok client credentials and strengthen Meta protocol handling against clearly identified fixtures.
acceptance: No required credentials means not_connected and zero network calls.
Exact IDs survive i64 values; pagination and retries are bounded.
Tokens stay in memory; errors/status never expose credentials.
Documented examples and synthetic fixtures are not called live recordings.
evidence: tests/tiktok-commercial.test.ts: token flow, no-key network guard, exact i64 IDs, cursor binding and error sanitisation
tests/meta-connector.test.ts: fixture pagination, missing reach, observed zero and disconnected status
Genuine provider recordings/live approval remain a separate blocked sign-off task.

tasks.title: Validate approved APIs against genuine sanitised recordings
tasks.goal: Verify approved Meta/TikTok endpoint access on Render and retain safe real response fixtures.
acceptance: Keys stay in secure Render settings, never chat or repository.
Success, empty, denied, rate-limited and paginated actual responses are reviewed without credentials.
Fixture-tested and live-verified statuses remain distinct.
checks: Render-only connector verification with approved keys
blockers: TikTok keys are not set; approved runtime API access and genuine Meta recordings are not yet supplied.

tasks.title: Durable worker and shared artifacts
tasks.goal: Separate web, PostgreSQL queue and extraction worker; implement scoped artifact transport.
acceptance: A worker never assumes access to the web service private disk.
Scoped hash-verified artifact interface, lease, retry and cancellation tests pass.
No browser or local ML session starts on the web service.
Authentication/permission failures pause until corrected; transient retries are bounded and cannot silently replay uncertain paid work.
evidence: Scoped authenticated web broker and separate verified worker cache implemented; no shared disk assumption.
Additive PostgreSQL queue uses canonical native IDs, idempotency keys, fenced leases, checkpoints, cancellation and bounded retries.
Staging is opt-in and makes no paid calls; candidate extraction remains disabled.
Existing Meta queue now pauses on permission/budget errors and caps transient failures per page.
324 unit/regression tests and 20 disposable PostgreSQL integration tests pass; production build passes.
Real loopback API -> PostgreSQL -> authenticated broker -> separate worker cache -> media-ready result passes without provider calls or inference reservations.

tasks.title: Verify broker and worker staging on Render
tasks.goal: Check one retained creative transfer and worker restart using secure service configuration.
acceptance: Only permitted canonical workspaces are readable with the dedicated service token.
A retained file stages as media-ready; repeat/restart does not duplicate the job or paid work.
No ML/model/browser work starts on web or status reads.
checks: Render-only staged-media transfer and restart check
blockers: Dedicated broker token, workspace allowlist and worker cache/origin are not yet configured in Render.

tasks.title: Dedupe, normalisation and scenes
tasks.goal: Cache exact media features and extract bounded source-timed frames using ffmpeg/PySceneDetect.
acceptance: Identical media and stage versions reuse features.
Frame/audio byte and duration limits are enforced.
Near-duplicate similarity never silently reuses labels as an exact match.
Worker cache quota, disk headroom and artifact retention are bounded before production extraction.

tasks.title: Speech and audio features
tasks.goal: Integrate pinned faster-whisper and YAMNet stages on the worker.
acceptance: Spoken voiceover is separated from music/lyrics.
Silence and stage failure are distinct.
Model versions, source times, quality and peak RSS are recorded.
blockers: Model weights/licences and the worker memory limit need explicit selection.

tasks.title: OCR and visual presence features
tasks.goal: Integrate RapidOCR and versioned face/product detectors.
acceptance: OCR is source-timed and deduplicated.
Face presence never becomes identity/demographics.
Product candidates never become verified brand identity without evidence.
blockers: Pin model weights and verify licences before production.

tasks.title: Compact Flash-Lite label adapter
tasks.goal: Use bounded evidence, fixed schema and labels-only output with minimal thinking.
acceptance: No full video or repeated transcript output in the cheap request.
Stable instructions precede dynamic evidence.
Requested/served model, thought/input/output/cache tokens and distinct GBP accounting are retained.
A cache hit avoids paid dispatch.
blockers: Model-specific GBP rates and a Render-only smoke test are required.
evidence: server/kernel/labels-prompt.ts and kernel-prompt.test.ts provide a pure bounded request/validation foundation; paid worker dispatch is not implemented or enabled.

tasks.title: Versioned quality escalation
tasks.goal: Escalate weak evidence under calibrated, capped, budgeted rules.
acceptance: Self-reported model confidence alone never triggers spend.
Escalation caps and budget guards stop further dispatch.
Restart does not replay uncertain paid attempts.
blockers: Calibrate thresholds on a labelled development split.

tasks.title: Paired reference/candidate evaluation
tasks.goal: Compare both methods on identical human-labelled media hashes.
acceptance: Report per-field accuracy and error cases, not only one aggregate score.
Report full worker/storage/model cost and escalation rate.
Keep a held-out evaluation split and versioned results.
blockers: Required labelled set and measured quality/cost release thresholds.

acceptance: Reference pipeline remains available.
No heavy extraction in the 512MB web process.
Connection states reflect actual approval/configuration.
Rollback preserves paid results and media.
